entry.use_when: compare what the same concepts mean and do across supplied works
entry.yields: concept-by-work map with supported continuities and changes

entry.use_when: trace how a text credits and uses borrowed ideas, and what actually changes across supplied works
entry.yields: borrowing and use tables with attribution and limits
entry.row_unit: one row per attributed use or supported change

entry.use_when: see how supplied works present continuity, qualification and revision
entry.yields: position map and revision record with earlier qualifications
entry.row_unit: one row per supported relation between positions

entry.use_when: test a supposition, the conditions it holds fixed and the strongest alternative route
entry.yields: supposition and dependency tables with conclusions that survive
entry.row_unit: one row per supposition or alternative

entry.use_when: trace opposed positions, responses and unresolved limits without assuming every text resolves them
entry.row_unit: one row per supported tension or transition

entry.use_when: separate what a text says must, may or cannot happen and under which conditions
entry.yields: modal claims with speakers, scope, backing and examples
entry.row_unit: one row per scoped possibility or necessity claim

entry.use_when: distinguish a term’s local senses, neighbors, contrasts and speakers
entry.yields: meaning and contrast inventories with separate evidence for each sense
entry.row_unit: one row per local sense or contrast

entry.use_when: map the lenses, components and relations a text uses to explain its object
entry.row_unit: one row per component, relation or application

entry.use_when: follow an exposition’s sequence, voices, time and qualifications
entry.yields: sequence and perspective maps suited to the text’s genre
entry.row_unit: one row per sequence, perspective or temporal move

entry.use_when: see how a text selects resources, combines mechanisms and bounds its contribution
entry.yields: construction and evidence tables retaining each distinct contribution
entry.row_unit: one row per input, construction move or evidential limit

entry.use_when: test a comparison’s relevant similarities, defeating differences, criteria and alternatives
entry.row_unit: one row per comparison or supported criterion

entry.use_when: compare how supplied sources answer shared questions and where their scope differs
entry.yields: shared-question reconciliation and source-attributed theme coverage
entry.row_unit: one row per aligned question or evidenced theme
